name: Sword
source:
"No matter what happens after this, no matter what you might lose, will you still believe in me?"

The number one Hunter associated with Bountia, he's S class. 
The cool and collected type, but when it comes to criminals he acts exceedingly cruel.
He has looked after Nasca since she was young and raised her as a Hunter, he's sort of a big brotherly existence for her.

Age: [spoiler]25[/spoiler]
Real Name: [spoiler]Travis[/spoiler]
